acceptance_meaning: The audited candidate R2 payload is accepted as the content of the canonical current-mainline pointer, and the bound governance amendment is accepted. This is a governance / authorization decision. It is not a scientific interpretation, changes no accepted result, closes no finding and grants no execution authority. It takes effect only when the canonical pointer is activated from this closure and published.
